anodizing_fixture.status: Supplier fixture confirmation remains open for the three slot-only panels. Removing dedicated holes does not establish that existing joining slots are approved anodizing fixture points.

assumptions: New side joint stations are +/-95 mm, adjusted from the drawing proportions to clear original rail-end screw heads; front/back stations retain R10 +/-59.5 mm.
0.8 mm nylon separator plus 0.1 mm clearance per face fits in a 1.0 mm sheet-edge gap.
Floor and case outer envelope stay unchanged; wall lower edges and front/back widths are trimmed for the nylon separator.
Existing metal L brackets remain as reinforcement; nylon connectors establish panel positions.
Lid wall screws join lid segments only. The lid remains lift-off and does not lock to the body.
Upper vertical corner bracket/slot axis lowers fromZ66.5 toZ65 to clear original rail-end screw heads with nuts inside.
Body screws useM5x12 with2mm total outside nylon,1mm washer; front/back vertical-corner and floor nuts h2.7; paired nuts h4 give1.3mm nominal nut-to-nut clearance.
Assemble corner nuts with a slim open wrench before installing the rail frame; a generic socket is not verified.
6mm feet are a provisional replacement for the3mm reference feet to clear bottom screw heads.
Vertical corner screw ears are24mm wide:15.5mm slot plus4.25mm material eachend; this clears original outside rail-mount washers byatleast1.46mm.

R11-02 removes both side-center lower wall/floor station pairs because the middle printed spans are continuous. The two remaining side clamps are 190 mm apart; identical stiffness or a load rating is not established.

All six dedicated 4 mm hanging holes are removed. The ten original rail mounting holes and eight lid plate bolt holes remain. Existing joining slots are not yet confirmed as supplier anodizing fixture points for the floor, front and back sheets.
